name: Ettercap
summary: A spiderlike humanoid that spins webs and bites with venom.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ettercap makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: and the target has the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.

actions.name: Web Strand

save.targets: one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet

actions.onFailure: The target has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; {ref:glossary/vulnerability} to Fire damage; {ref:glossary/immunity} to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

bonusActions.name: Reel
bonusActions.text: The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is {ref:condition/restrained} by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.
